Migration complete. All Pages Router routes and files have been moved to the App Router, the `pages/` directory is fully removed, and `tsc --noEmit` + `next build` both pass.

## What was migrated

| Pages Router (removed) | App Router (new) | API changes |
|---|---|---|
| `_app.js` + `_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` | `next/head` → `metadata` export; `next/font/google` `Inter` replaces the `<link>` font; global CSS imported here |
| `pages/index.js` (`getServerSideProps`) | `app/page.tsx` | `getServerSideProps` → async server component; `req.headers` → `headers()` from `next/headers`; `useRouter().push` → split into a `'use client'` `ViewAllPostsButton` |
| `pages/blog/index.js` (`getStaticProps`, `revalidate:60`) | `app/blog/page.tsx` | inline fetch + `export const revalidate = 60`; `router.push` → `ReadMoreButton` client component |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` (`getStaticPaths`/`getStaticProps`, `fallback:'blocking'`, `revalidate:300`) | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` + `loading.tsx` | `getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams`; `dynamicParams = true` preserves blocking fallback; `router.isFallback` UI → `loading.tsx`; `notFound: true` → `notFound()` from `next/navigation`; `Head` metadata → `generateMetadata` |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` | `next/router` → `next/navigation` `useRouter`; `next/head` → handled by layout `metadata` |
| `pages/_error.js` (`getInitialProps`) | `app/error.tsx` | `getInitialProps` (removed API) → React error boundary receiving `{ error, reset }` |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts` | Pages API `handler(req,res)` → Route Handlers `GET`/`POST` with `NextRequest`/`NextResponse`; 405 fallback dropped (unmatched methods auto-405) |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` | `req.query` → awaited `params` Promise; `GET`/`PUT`/`DELETE` exports |
| `components/AppProvider.js` | `components/AppProvider.tsx` | Added `'use client'`, typed context interface, typed props/return |

All new files use TypeScript with explicit interfaces for `Post`, `Comment`, route params, and context values. The build output confirms the routing semantics match the originals (dynamic home, ISR blog at 1m, SSG blog posts at 5m with 10 prerendered paths, dynamic API routes).
